visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and a black button-down shirt stands in a bright, modern kitchen. He gestures with his hands towards a white induction stove area where a purple pot is visible. The background features light-toned cabinets, tiled walls, and kitchen utensils hanging neatly. (2) Close-up shots focus on a person's hands efficiently slicing white onions and green celery stalks on a white cutting board. The movements are quick and deliberate, emphasizing the preparation process. A piece of raw pork meat is also visible on the side of the board. (3) The scene shifts to a purple Dutch oven on a gas stove. Sliced onions are tossed in, followed by celery and carrots. A black spatula stirs the mixture. Then, thin strips of raw meat are added and sautéed until partially cooked. (4) The man speaks directly to the camera while stirring the food, displaying the 'LE CREUSET' logo on the lid of the purple pot. He demonstrates the cooking process in the kitchen environment with warm, bright lighting that highlights the food. (5) Various sauces and seasonings are added from bottles into the pot. The man stirs the ingredients until a glossy sauce forms. The camera uses close-up shots to capture the steam and texture of the black pepper pork strips. (6) The man sits at a small table and eats the dish using black chopsticks. He exhibits a high-arousal facial expression of enjoyment and gives a thumbs-up. The lighting remains bright and natural, focusing on his reaction. (7) A fast transition occurs to a large warehouse retail environment. The man holds a red pot lid and shouts excitedly. Rows of orange boxes and colorful cookware are stacked on shelves under bright fluorescent lighting. (8) The man walks through the store aisles, pointing at price signs indicating discounts. He holds different colored pots and kitchen tools, demonstrating their features to the viewer in a highly energetic and promotional manner. (9) The video concludes with the man holding a large orange shopping bag with the brand logo. He smiles broadly and gestures toward the camera in the bustling store setting filled with cookware displays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-arousal male voice begins narrating enthusiastically in a domestic kitchen setting. The speech rate is fast and clear, accompanied by an upbeat electronic BGM featuring a steady synthesizer pulse and rhythmic drum beat. (2) A distinct 'sizzling' sound effect triggers a new phase as meat hits the pan. The speaker continues describing the cooking steps with energetic vocal inflections. The BGM maintains a consistent volume under the vocals. (3) A percussive 'click' and 'clinking' sound of cookware occurs. The speaker's voice remains dominant with high valence, expressing excitement about the cooking method. The music continues without interruption. (4) A vocalized 'mmm' sound of satisfaction is heard as the man tastes the dish. This is followed by a short, melodic 'ding' sound effect used for emphasis. The BGM beat remains strong and bright. (5) The acoustic texture shifts as the speaker moves to a large retail store. Background ambient crowd murmurs and room reverberation are audibly present. The speaker's volume increases, and his tone becomes more promotional. (6) A 'whoosh' transition sound plays as the man points to sale items. The BGM remains energetic while the speaker shouts brand names and discount details in a high-arousal delivery. (7) A 'rustling' sound of a large shopping bag triggers the final phase. The speaker concludes with a high-pitched, joyful exclamation. The electronic BGM and speech overlap until a sharp hard cut at the end.
